column1: # mapping_set_description: "Term-level alignment of the WHS Metadata Application Profile (MAP 2.0) to DCMI Terms, CIDOC CRM, schema.org, EDM, Wikidata and DBpedia. Records, for every attribute of the domain model, the selected term and the correspondences to candidate terms in other vocabularies, with the reason for the selection."

column7: comment
Selected: dcterms:identifier (primary vocabulary). CRM reifies the identifier as an E42 node; produced by crm-view.rq.
Candidate not selected (parsimony: primary vocabulary has the term).
Selected: dcterms:source (MAP 2.0). Actionable provenance link to https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/{id}.
Selected: schema:version. dcterms:hasVersion relates two resources, whereas the value here is an ordinal integer; DCMI has no suitable term.
Selected: dcterms:title. Language-tagged literal suffices; CRM appellation node produced by crm-view.rq.
Candidate not selected (primary vocabulary has the term).
Selected: dcterms:description.
New in MAP 2.0 (replaces schema:description). Refinement of the primary vocabulary.
Also asserted as rdfs:subPropertyOf in whs-alignment.ttl.
Rejected: dcterms:provenance is a statement of changes in ownership and custody; the justification states Outstanding Universal Value.
New in MAP 2.0. Also asserted as rdfs:subClassOf in whs-alignment.ttl.
Selected: dcterms:dateAccepted. In CRM the inscription is an E7 Activity with an E52 Time-Span; produced by crm-view.rq.
Selected: dcterms:date (generic by nature).
Selected: geo:lat (WGS84 datum explicit in the term semantics). DCMI has no term.
Selected: geo:long. DCMI has no term.
crm-view.rq builds an E53 Place defined by a WKT point.
Selected: dbo:areaTotal, square metres, xsd:decimal (MAP 2.0; MAP 1.0 used hectares with xsd:double). DCMI has no term. CRM E54 node produced by crm-view.rq.
Selected: wdt:P2614 with the ten Wikidata criterion items (stable, multilingual). DCMI has no specific term; dcterms:subject would lose the meaning.
New in MAP 2.0 (replaces edm:country). Refinement of the primary vocabulary.
Not a sub-property: P17 values are Wikidata items, WHS values are TGN URIs.
Used in MAP 1.0; withdrawn because edm:country takes a literal country name on EDM aggregations.
Also asserted as rdfs:subPropertyOf in whs-alignment.ttl.
New in MAP 2.0 (replaces direct use of dcterms:spatial). Refinement of the primary vocabulary.
Also asserted as rdfs:subPropertyOf in whs-alignment.ttl.
Selected: schema:sameAs (identity reference without OWL identity entailment, which would merge WHS and Wikidata statements).
CRM-native: E18 (a subclass of E77) was present at an E5 Event.
Selected: dcterms:subject with the danger-type VES (UNESCO Thesaurus excerpt).
Selected: dcterms:temporal with EDTF intervals. CRM time-spans produced by crm-view.rq.
